notes: The three operations a room calls on the guest-identity component, passed in as services.identity (IdentityService in implementation/server/adapter.ts; createIdentityApi(settings) from guest-identity satisfies it, with its name and rotation settings already bound). Each room keeps its own IdentityBook in its storage record; this component imports nothing from guest-identity.

claim.returns: IdentityResult<{book:IdentityBook,id:string,token:string,rejoined:boolean}> (called on join; the guest's earlier token stops working; a refusal is answered 422 with the given code, for example badName)

authenticate.returns: {book:IdentityBook,id:string,name:string,rotatedToken:string|null}|null (called on every request and live message; a non-null rotatedToken is sent to the device in the x-rotated-token header or a {type:"token"} live message, and the room keeps the returned book)

release.returns: IdentityBook (called when a player or spectator leaves)
